decision.explanation: The question asks for the construction date of 'the Douglas County Courthouse' without specifying a state. The provided sources describe four distinct courthouses with this name in different locations, each with a unique construction date: 1) Douglas County Courthouse (Nebraska) has conflicting records in the sources (D1S2 states 1912, D2S2 states 1895), both referring to the same entity but presenting contradictory claims; 2) Douglas County Courthouse (Wisconsin) was built in 1918-1919 (D3S2); 3) Douglas County Courthouse (Illinois) was completed in 1913 (D5S2). Since the prompt allows for distinct valid namesakes and requires preserving all valid referents, all four dates found in the source text are included as they correspond to different buildings or conflicting claims about the Nebraska building.
